schema_rules.resolution: Each entries row has reference_id/category/status/reason/assessment. implementation, normal_entry, permission, backend_dependencies, supported_versions and acceptance resolve through assessments[row.assessment]; optional row.review fields override reviewed values.
schema_rules.aliases: Aliases are separate reference IDs and require their own actual registry key; no automatic inheritance of base support.
schema_rules.exports: Native export reference IDs are native_export.<module>.<ordinal>; all other IDs come from the immutable inventory, aliases use onebot.alias.<key>.
schema_rules.acceptance: declared/implemented/wired/offline/native/field/production are separate. Registered, partial_offline, research_lab and implemented_pending_validation never imply native acceptance.
schema_rules.missing: No audited equivalent handler/normal entry; no credit for placeholders, file existence, learned-only caches or reference-only evidence.
schema_rules.refresh: Regenerate derived rows and assessment profiles. Preserve rows with a manual review and profiles with reviewed: true. Reject missing reference IDs and validate all resulting rows.
